name: What kind of maintenance does hardwood flooring require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does hardwood flooring require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardwood flooring requires regular maintenance to preserve its appearance and longevity. This includes sweeping or vacuuming regularly to remove dirt and grit, which can scratch the surface. Use a damp mop with a pH-neutral wood cleaner, avoiding excessive water. Place mats at entryways to minimize dirt and use furniture pads to prevent scratches. Periodic professional refinishing may be needed every 7-10 years, depending on wear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular maintenance includes sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning with a damp mop and wood cleaner. Use mats and furniture pads, and consider periodic refinishing.
